### B1102688 — Generated files conflict on every fresh clone because the merge driver is only registered by npm install `[repo]` (task) #infra #testing

`[x]` **SHIPPED.** `AUDIT-FIRST` finding first: the item as reported named "MAP.md and docs/archive/BACKLOG-DONE.md" as both already having "a git merge driver configured." That was only half true — `.gitattributes` named the custom `merge=planyr-ledger` driver (needing `npm install`'s local git config to do anything) for **MAP.md and BACKLOG_OPEN.md only**; `docs/archive/BACKLOG-DONE.md` carried **no merge attribute at all** and was always on the fully-manual `resolve-ledgers.mjs` path (deliberately — see that script's header on why a blind `merge=union` there is unsafe for the file that's the single source of truth for what's open — that reasoning is about `BACKLOG.md`, not this archive). Both halves are now fixed, with the "why not just union" trade-off made explicit rather than assumed:

- **MAP.md / BACKLOG_OPEN.md — a two-layer fix, so nobody's existing behavior regresses.** `.gitattributes` now names git's own **built-in, zero-config `union` driver** directly (gitattributes(5) — no local config exists, so `merge.<name>.driver` can never be the reason it's unarmed). Since both files are wholly REGENERATED from other inputs, a union merge can never be wrong in a way that matters — `scripts/post-merge-regen.mjs` (unchanged, already existed) corrects it against the complete tree after every merge regardless of which driver produced the intermediate content. `npm install` / `npm run hooks:install` (`scripts/install-hooks.mjs`, extended) now ALSO writes a **local, uncommitted `.git/info/attributes` override** pointing these same two paths back at the smarter custom `planyr-ledger` driver (inline regeneration during the merge itself, the B384432 hand-authored-description safety check, real abort-on-regen-failure) — `.git/info/attributes` takes precedence over the committed `.gitattributes` for the same reason `merge.<name>.driver` is local-only: a repo cannot make an arbitrary clone execute an arbitrary command with zero action from whoever is cloning it. Proven both ways with real git, not mocked: a bare fresh clone (no install, no `.git/info/attributes`) merges cleanly via `union` alone; an installed clone gets the *exact same* smart-driver behavior as before, unchanged (`test/mergeDriverE2E.test.js`'s existing 7 scenarios all still pass against the new two-layer setup).
- **docs/archive/BACKLOG-DONE.md** gets the built-in `union` driver directly too — no local-override upgrade exists or is planned for it (it doesn't need one: its conflicts are hand-authored text, not a generated file needing inline regeneration). The one case union can get wrong — two branches editing the exact SAME already-closed entry, rather than each archiving a different one — is the overwhelming minority of real conflicts here (the majority are independent archivals, which union always gets right) and is caught **loudly**, not silently, by the pre-existing `test/idUniqueness.test.js` cross-file duplicate-id guard (proven directly in the new test suite below, reusing the exact same `findDuplicateIds`/`B_FILES` CI already runs — no new detection code). `BACKLOG.md`/`VERIFICATION.md`/`docs/archive/VERIFICATION-DONE.md` deliberately stay off this and were not touched — see `scripts/resolve-ledgers.mjs`'s amended header for why that reasoning still holds for them.
- **VERIFIED LIKE A HUMAN, not just by the new automated suite** — a real `git init` fixture (not this sandbox's own shallow-cloned checkout, whose disconnected shallow-history boundary makes `git clone`/`merge-base` fail for reasons unrelated to this fix; confirmed via `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` → `true` here), the real committed files, zero `npm install`: two branches each regenerating MAP.md and archiving a different new item merged with `git merge` exit 0, `Auto-merging MAP.md` / `Auto-merging docs/archive/BACKLOG-DONE.md`, empty `git status --short` after, both sides' content present. Repeated with the real installer actually run (`node scripts/install-hooks.mjs`): the SAME merge is resolved by the smart driver instead (`✅ merge driver: regenerated MAP.md — both sides reconciled`, its own `.planyr-ledger-merges.log` line `"outcome":"resolved"`), followed by the post-merge backstop staging its usual correction (`M  MAP.md`) — proving the installed path is byte-for-byte the same behavior as before this change.
- **New: `test/freshCloneMerge.test.js`** (7 tests) — the literal acceptance criterion as a permanent regression guard: reads the REAL committed `.gitattributes` off disk (never retyped, so it can't silently drift from what ships), builds a bare fresh clone with no install step of any kind, and requires all three files to merge with zero shown conflict across two branches that legitimately touch them; a known-good arm proves the harness itself works independent of this fix; a dedicated case proves the ONE documented residual risk (two branches editing the same BACKLOG-DONE.md entry) merges clean via union AND is caught by the real duplicate-id detector.
- **Extended `test/mergeDriverE2E.test.js`** (`installAll()` helper folding in the new `installAttributesOverride` call) and **`test/installHooks.test.js`** (+21 tests: `attributesOverridePlan`/`attrMergeValue`/`stripPathLines`/`installAttributesOverride` pure-decision and real-filesystem coverage — idempotent, never clobbers a foreign customization, `--force` opt-in, `--check` never writes) to prove the upgrade path exactly as thoroughly as the two decisions it sits beside.
- Verify: sandbox — pure git/tooling mechanism, no UI, no timing/GIS/PDF/real-project-data dependency; proven by real git operations in throwaway repos plus the manual protocol above, not by assumption.
- **Gate:** `npx vitest run` — 701 files / 14,441 tests, all green. `npm run lint` — 0 errors (29 pre-existing warnings, none in touched files). `npm run build` — clean. `node scripts/build-map.mjs --check` / `node scripts/build-backlog-index.mjs --check` — no drift (this change touches no `src/` file and no `BACKLOG.md` open item). `node scripts/check-mint.mjs --ci` — clean against freshly-fetched `origin/main` and all in-flight branches. `node ui-audit/perf-bundle-audit.mjs --compare .perf/base-stats.json` — all budgets within ceiling, this branch's own delta **+0.0 KB on every metric** (every reported drift belongs to `main`, not this change). Also ran clean: `ui-audit/stress/check-babel.mjs`, `ui-audit/required-check-audit.mjs`, `ui-audit/gis-source-audit.mjs`, `scripts/verification-queue-audit.mjs --check`, `scripts/build-fixtures.mjs --check`, `scripts/build-landing-coverage.mjs --check`, `node ui-audit/doc-pointer-audit.mjs`. The two browser-driven gates (Playwright/visual-regression/signature-budget) were not run: this change touches zero files under `src/`, `public/`, or any rendering path (`git diff --stat` against base — `.gitattributes`, `scripts/`, `test/` only), so pixel/DOM-signature output cannot differ.
- Files: `.gitattributes`, `scripts/install-hooks.mjs`, `scripts/merge-driver-ledgers.mjs` (header only), `scripts/resolve-ledgers.mjs` (header only), `test/installHooks.test.js`, `test/mergeDriverE2E.test.js`, `test/freshCloneMerge.test.js` (new).
